items.title: Pam the Bird graffiti vandal in stand-off with police on Melbourne bridge
items.description: A trespasser remains attached to a 140- metre-high tower of the Bolte Bridge in Melbourne after spray-painting the surface with the notorious graffiti symbol.

items.title: Families told accused Bali bomber Hambali to face 202 life terms
items.description: US military prosecutors reveal new details about their case against the man accused of planning the 2002 Bali bombings, telling the loved ones of Australian victims his trial could finally begin next year.

items.title: 'Bad blood' between US and European allies as NATO summit begins
items.description: Dozens of world leaders are descending on Türkiye this week to rubber-stamp significant NATO commitments, but the sideline dynamics could prove more interesting to watch.

items.title: WorkSafe investigates after footballer suffers life-ending head injuries
items.description: Victoria's workplace safety watchdog is investigating after a suburban footy player was injured, and later died, after his head collided with a cricket pitch.

items.title: Australia urged to sign treaty banning nuclear weapons
items.description: There are renewed calls for Australia to sign a treaty ensuring nuclear weapons can't ever be facilitated, stored or manufactured in Australia.

items.title: One in every class: AI-assisted sexual abuse widespread among teens
items.description: About one in every 25 Australians under the age of 18 has been the victim or knows a victim of artificial intelligence-assisted online sexual abuse, according to a new study.

items.title: Donald Trump teaches crypto devotees a valuable lesson
items.description: US President Donald Trump should have been a godsend to the mysterious world of cryptocurrency. Instead, it has been a godsend to him.

items.title: 'A lot of stigma': The 'taboo' cancer side effects we don't talk about
items.description: Shame and stigma mean gynaecological side effects from cancer treatment — affecting women's sexual, urinary and reproductive health — are under-reported and under-researched.

items.title: Live: Portugal and Spain deadlocked in battle of generational stars
items.description: Portugal takes on Spain in a clash between two Iberian neighbours in Dallas, Texas, after Cristiano Ronaldo confirms this will be his last World Cup. Follow live.

items.title: China warns Australia over landmark military alliance in the Pacific
items.description: China has warned Australia not to harm its interests in the Pacific after Anthony Albanese struck a landmark military alliance with Fiji.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
